_comment: Model-data name normalization for the cell life-cycle (template A). The Vantage RA model names a cell's rate parameters with several inconsistent prefixes (abbreviations, a 'Macrophase' typo). This maps each canonical cell (steady_state_targets model_species) to the prefixes seen in parameter names, so the general engine needs no per-name hardcoding. TCell/Lympho are parent pools with no direct steady-state target and are intentionally omitted.
